arc.identity_limit: Replay GUID is not a participant ID. Environment holdout, not verified participant holdout.
arc.action_target: next ARC action ID, after preceding returned frame
arc.duration_target: actions until first attainment of the next level; final unfinished level censored
arc.notice_label: unobserved; frame stagnation is only a predictive proxy

lab.action_target: next sampled avatar displacement in 9 sign directions (includes stay); not keypress
lab.duration_target: seconds until next recorded harvest; censored at last field observation
lab.privacy: No pair names, original filenames, absolute timestamps, or participant identifiers exported

janssen.group_unit: whole experimental session across all rounds
janssen.action_target: next recorded movement direction or token collection, per participant
janssen.duration_target: positive seconds between recorded movement/harvest events; no inferred terminal censor
janssen.duration_limit: Conditional on a subsequent recorded event, not an unconditional waiting-time distribution.
janssen.privacy: No UUID, network address, station number, chat text, or absolute timestamp exported
janssen.source: DeCaro, DeCaro, Janssen, Lee, Graci & Flener (2024), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0307832, OSF v3drm
